title: Code engineering path handout (modules 16–18)
subtitle: Brief → VSR → PACKET → Soft DoD – use this as a one-project checklist in Cursor.
briefSteps: Goal sentence – what must work after 1–2 hours (not “improve the code”).
Bounds – files, stack, what not to touch, and when AI must ask instead of guessing.
Success criteria – 1–3 checkable signals (smoke, diff, manual check).
VSR phase – are you in Vibe (sketch), Skeleton (structure), or Refinement (tighten)?
packetChecklist: PROJECT_RULES.md – tone, bans, stack, and “don’t change without asking”.
Brief / task – one file or a clear agent message.
Context files – only what this slice needs.
Test or smoke – how you will know a commit is worth it.
Diff ritual – what you review before merge (no blind Accept All).
softDodChecks: Boot – app or script starts without an obvious error.
Smoke – 1–2 critical paths you checked yourself.
Diff – changes match the brief; no bonus refactor.
Journal – one line: what worked / what you will repeat next time.
promptPatterns: Brief: goal, bounds, success criteria, VSR phase – no long backstory.
Rules: follow PROJECT_RULES; if context is missing – ask, don’t guess.
Diff: list files and risk; don’t touch unrelated modules.
Smoke: after the change, run [command] and report PASS/FAIL with a reason.
starterPrompt:
META: You are a coding assistant in Cursor. Goal – one vertical slice, not a large refactor.
INPUT: Brief: [what must work]. Bounds: [files / do not touch]. Stack: [tech]. VSR phase: [Vibe / Skeleton / Refinement].
OUTPUT: (1) 3–5 step plan, (2) file list, (3) smoke check, (4) short diff summary.
QUALITY: If context is missing – ask. Don’t invent APIs or secrets. Soft DoD: boot + smoke + diff review before commit.
reflectionSummary: Within 24–48h run one real brief in Cursor: PACKET + Soft DoD. Note which VSR phase you were in and one rule you will add to PROJECT_RULES.
nextPageIntro: The code path is done when you have more than a chat with AI: a brief, a PACKET, smoke, and a commit you can repeat.
